description: Returns Google search results as clean, chunked, metadata-rich text optimized for embedding pipelines and vector databases. No LLM required. Each chunk includes: text, source URL, domain, title, date, word count, and chunk index. Perfect for RAG pipelines, semantic search, and AI grounding.

freshness.description: Time filter: pd=past day pw=week pm=month py=year any=none (historical). Pass pd/pw/pm/py whenever the user asks for latest/current/recent results ("today", "this week", "latest", current year); omit or "any" for timeless or historical questions. The response footer echoes the filter that was applied.

include_paa.description: Include "People Also Ask" Q&A pairs as extra chunks. Default: true.

link_resolution.description: Google result links beyond the top 3 may come back as google.com/goto redirects. "auto" (default): top 3 resolved, any leftover goto links get a search_id for resolve_links. "all": also resolve every link now (free, but adds ~30 s when goto links are present). "none": fastest, links exactly as Google returns them.

max_chunk_words.description: Maximum words per chunk (default 200). Lower = more chunks, finer granularity.

num_results.description: Number of web results to fetch (1–20, default 10).

output_format.description: "json" (structured, for vector DBs) or "text" (plain blocks, for direct prompt use). Default: "json".

query.description: Search query to retrieve and chunk.

name: search_rag_context
